governing_equation: u_t + (u.grad)u + grad p = nu*Delta u ; div u = 0
implementation_notes: 2-D incompressible Navier-Stokes, Taylor-Green vortex -- an EXACT closed-form solution on the periodic box [0,2*pi]^2. Report fields at t=0.5. Multi-field: solve_pde(N) returns fields={u,v,p} each of shape (N,N) plus grid={x,y} built from np.linspace(0,2*pi,N). Run at N=48 and N=96. Scored on relative L2 of the velocity (u,v) < 1% at the finer grid, plus observed spatial-convergence-order p=log2(err_N/err_2N) >= 1.5 on primary field u. Pressure p is compared AFTER removing its mean (defined only up to a constant), hence gauge_fields=[p]. The divergence_norm diagnostic is a HARD GATE: the discrete div u must stay near zero or the solution fails as CONSTRAINT_VIOLATION regardless of accuracy -- use a projection / pressure-Poisson (FFT on the periodic box) scheme rather than a collocated central update. Analytic velocity decays as exp(-2*nu*t); pressure as exp(-4*nu*t).
